name: Natural Edge Furniture
old_description: Natural Edge Furniture crafts timeless, custom furniture from premium wood slabs salvaged responsibly from the Pacific Northwest. Our expert craftsmen help you with design and make recommendations on wood species to help your vision become reality. We specialize in large dining and conference tables, desks, occasional tables and benches.
about:
Based in the Maker's District of Bend, Oregon, Natural Edge Furniture builds custom furniture from premium wood slabs salvaged from the Pacific Northwest. The company operates as Natural Edge Furniture & Supply, offering both finished pieces and a slab inventory for customer projects.

The shop specializes in large dining and conference tables, desks, occasional tables, and benches. Expert craftsmen assist with design and wood-species recommendations, milling and finishing slabs such as walnut, blue pine, African sapele, white oak, madrone, hickory, elm, and fumed white oak. The facility also maintains a stock of live-edge slabs for direct purchase.

Customers include residential buyers seeking one-of-a-kind tables and benches, as well as commercial clients needing conference tables and office furniture. Interior designers and woodworkers also source slabs from the inventory for their own projects.

Natural Edge Furniture emphasizes environmental responsibility, stating it continually reduces its carbon footprint through energy-efficient operations, waste minimization, sourcing from suppliers with green manufacturing practices, and ongoing recycling and donation programs.
